Datasets & Metrics.We evaluate ThreadRAG on three standard open-domain multi-hop QA benchmarks: HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), 2WikiMultihopQA (Ho et al., 2020), and MuSiQue (Trivedi et al., 2022). We use the same data splits as previous works (Trivedi et al., 2023; Li and Du, 2023) for evaluation. Following IRCoT (Trivedi et al., 2023), our retrieval corpus aggregates all supporting and distractor passages to simulate a realistic open-domain setting. For evaluation, we report Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores to measure absolute correctness and token-level overlap, applying standard text normalization to both predictions and ground-truth answers prior to computation.

Baselines. We evaluate ThreadRAG against five categories of baselines: text-centric multi-hop methods reasoning purely over plain text (RA-CoT (Wei et al., 2022), ReAct (Yao et al., 2022), IRCoT (Trivedi et al., 2023), Self-Ask (Press et al., 2023), Iter-RetGen (Shao et al., 2023)), KG-Chunk RAG methods treating text chunks as nodes (HippoRAG (Gutiérrez et al., 2024), LightRAG (Guo et al., 2024)), KG-Rewriting RAG methods converting subgraphs into natural language (CoTKR (Wu et al., 2024), EFSUM (Ko et al., 2024)), KGPath RAG methods reasoning along discrete structural paths (ToG (Sun et al., 2024), PoG (Tan et al., 2025)), and KG-Triplet RAG methods prompting with discrete relational triplets (ERA-CoT (Liu et al., 2024), KnowTrace (Li et al., 2025)). For fair comparison, we adapt ToG and PoG to use the same local KG as LightRAG, replacing their external KGs.

Implementation Details. We use Llama-3-8B (Grattafiori et al., 2024), Qwen-3.5-Plus (Yang et al., 2025), and GPT-4o-mini (OpenAI et al., 2024) with nomic-embed-text for embeddings (Nussbaum et al., 2024). Chunk size is 1200 characters with 150 overlap. We retrieve top-5 global contexts via Elasticsearch using equal BM25 and dense weights. STG settings are: 5-NN, 0.5/0.3 semantic/lexical thresholds, and edge weights γ = 0.3, α = 0.35, β = 0.65. Pathfinding parameters are: 3 anchors, 0.5 PPR restart, 0.01 pruning threshold, and 3 max iterations. All experiments run on 4 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs.
